promptSet.description:
NotebookLM Short Video Overviews – Turn Any PDF or Notes into 60-Second Animated Explainer Videos

Google NotebookLM introduces short vertical video overviews. Upload any PDF, research article, or class lecture, and NotebookLM automatically scripts, animates, and narrates a 60-second Reels-style explainer video.

Built for knowledge workers, tech operators, and fast-paced teams, NotebookLM Short Video Overviews removes administrative bottlenecks, automates high-frequency routines, and maximizes daily output.

Key Features:
• Go to notebooklm.google.com and create a new notebook.
• Upload your source PDF or lecture slides.
• Click Generate Short Video Overview and download your vertical MP4.
• Ready-to-post 60-second narrated video summarizing complex academic material.

Official Website: https://notebooklm.google.com/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DaSphZagb2F/
